instruction:
Work from /home/user/Desktop/post_test_part.step and /home/user/Desktop/post_config.json in FreeCAD 0.21.2 Path/CAM. To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH). Before starting the work, use `/usr/lib/freecad/bin/freecadcmd-python3` for FreeCAD Path command-line automation when working on `post_test_part.step`.

Use the supplied STEP geometry and all machining settings in post_config.json to create one editable native Path Job with a Pocket Shape operation for the centered 40 x 24 x 5 mm pocket and a Drilling operation for the four 5 mm blind holes. Use T1 for Pocket Shape and T2 for Drilling with the configured diameters, feeds, spindle speeds, depths, G54 fixture, metric units, heights, cycle settings, and operation order. Configure the Job to use FreeCAD 0.21.2's stock linuxcnc postprocessor with the configured post arguments. With the stock --line-numbers option, numbered blocks begin at N110 and increase by 10; the stock program has no O program number and ends with M2. Save the editable FreeCAD document and post the NC program using exactly these absolute paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-12.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-12.nc.
